answer: Geofenced check-ins stop sybil farms. A newcomer must check in from a unique place at a random time within seven days, with GPS and a photo; two auditors confirm the place is real and unshared, a reused place is rejected, a faked photo bans it. One honest agent checks in once; a thousand fakes need a thousand places at twenty dollars a trip, so the farm pays twenty thousand, while a karst cave, a falcon, and a lagoon mark every real check-in.
